content.comment_body: Thanks for your response. My intention is to create a clock using [product_name] and a Modbus TCP digital I/O module as a personal project, and I am searching for a method to obtain real-time data. This is especially relevant since [article_no] can synchronize with an NTP server. Unfortunately, the information shared did not address my need for accessing real-time data. Does anyone have alternative suggestions?

To clarify: It is not possible to directly access date and time information from within a [product_name] program. While date and time data exist in the VM memory area, they are stored outside the portion that a user can access through their program. The VM memory from VB0 to VB850 is available to users, while date and time are stored at VB984, which is not accessible from user code.

analysis.insight_summary: Users attempting to build a clock using a [product_name] controller and Modbus TCP I/O module encounter a major constraint: real-time clock data cannot be directly accessed within the user program. Despite the hardware supporting real-time synchronization through NTP, users express frustration because these features are not available for custom programming, limiting creative and time-based solutions.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to access real-time data—specifically date and time—directly in their [product_name] programs, particularly since the hardware supports NTP synchronization.
